stops.name: Christchurch Airport
highlights: Land and pick up the hire car
Get a local SIM or eSIM in the arrivals hall
stops.tip: The trip starts and ends here.

stops.name: Christchurch
highlights: Botanic Gardens and a punt on the Avon
Riccarton Bush farmers' market on Saturday morning
Gondola up the Port Hills for views over Lyttelton Harbour
stops.tip: Two easy days to get over jet lag before any driving.

pois.name: Christchurch Botanic Gardens
pois.notes: Free. Punting on the Avon leaves from the Antigua Boat Sheds nearby.

pois.name: Riccarton Bush Farmers' Market
pois.notes: Saturday mornings.

pois.name: Christchurch Gondola
pois.notes: Views over the city, the plains and Lyttelton Harbour.

stops.name: Kaikōura
highlights: Whale watching by boat; sperm whales live here year-round
Peninsula walkway past the seal colony
Crayfish from a roadside caravan
stops.tip: Tours cancel in rough seas. Three nights gives a spare day to rebook.

pois.name: Point Kean seal colony
pois.notes: Start of the Kaikōura Peninsula Walkway. Keep 20 m from the seals.

pois.name: Ohau Point
pois.notes: Roadside seal lookout north of town.

stops.name: Marlborough Sounds · Havelock
highlights: Short sections of the Queen Charlotte Track, with a boat to drop you off
Green-lipped mussel cruise from Havelock
Cycle between Blenheim cellar doors
stops.tip: Stay somewhere on the water and keep some days empty.

pois.name: Pelorus Bridge
pois.notes: River swimming hole and short bush walks.

pois.name: Wairau Valley wineries
pois.notes: Hire bikes in Renwick and ride between cellar doors.

stops.name: Abel Tasman · Kaiteriteri
highlights: Water taxi to a golden beach, walk an hour, get picked up
Half-day guided kayak with fur seals
Nelson's Saturday market and Māpua wharf
stops.tip: One of the sunniest corners of NZ, and a good place for beach days.

pois.name: Split Apple Rock
pois.notes: Short walk from Tokongawa Drive, or by kayak.

pois.name: Anchorage Bay
pois.notes: Popular water-taxi drop-off; walk back to Marahau (12 km) or just swim.

pois.name: Māpua Wharf
pois.notes: Fish and chips and small galleries.

pois.name: Nelson Saturday Market
pois.notes: Montgomery Square, Saturday mornings.

stops.name: Golden Bay · Tākaka
highlights: Te Waikoropupū Springs, some of the clearest water in the world
Wharariki Beach and its arches at low tide
Farewell Spit guided tour
stops.tip: A quiet place for Christmas. Shops close on 25 December, so stock up beforehand.

pois.name: Te Waikoropupū Springs
pois.notes: Sacred site: look, don't touch the water.

pois.name: Wharariki Beach
pois.notes: 20-minute walk over dunes. Go at low tide for the caves and arches.

pois.name: Labyrinth Rocks
pois.notes: Easy maze of limestone outcrops; fun with kids.

stops.name: Punakaiki
highlights: Pancake Rocks and blowholes, best at high tide
Pororari River track through nīkau palms
Wild beach sunsets
stops.tip: The longest drive of the trip. Break it in Murchison or at the Buller Gorge swing bridge.

pois.name: Pancake Rocks
pois.notes: 20-minute loop walk. Blowholes work best at high tide with a swell.

pois.name: Pororari River Track
pois.notes: Flat walk up a limestone gorge.

stops.name: Franz Josef
highlights: Glacier valley walk, or a heli-hike if the weather allows
Lake Matheson at dawn for the mirror view of Aoraki
Okārito lagoon kayak among herons
stops.tip: Sandflies are fierce on the West Coast, so bring repellent.

pois.name: Hokitika Gorge
pois.notes: On the way down: turquoise river and swing bridge. About 40 min detour.

pois.name: Franz Josef Glacier valley walk
pois.notes: About 1.5 h return to the viewpoint.

pois.name: Lake Matheson
pois.notes: Go early on a still morning for the reflection.

pois.name: Okārito
pois.notes: Kayak the lagoon; kōtuku (white heron) country.

stops.name: Wānaka
highlights: Blue Pools and waterfalls on the Haast Pass
Lake swims and the flat lakefront path to "That Wanaka Tree"
Rob Roy Glacier track in Mt Aspiring National Park
stops.tip: New Year by the lake. Five nights here, easy to fill with short walks and lake days.

pois.name: Blue Pools
pois.notes: On the Haast Pass drive in. 30-minute return walk.

pois.name: That Wanaka Tree
pois.notes: Short walk along the lakefront.

pois.name: Rob Roy Glacier Track
pois.notes: From Raspberry Creek car park, 3-4 h return. Gravel road with fords.

pois.name: Puzzling World
pois.notes: Good on a rainy day.

stops.name: Arrowtown & Queenstown
highlights: Gold-rush Arrowtown and the Chinese settlement
Lake Hayes loop walk or the Arrow River cycle trails
Gondola in Queenstown, then a drive to Glenorchy
stops.tip: Base in Arrowtown, which is calmer, and go into Queenstown for the day.

pois.name: Arrowtown Chinese Settlement
pois.notes: Restored huts of gold-rush era Chinese miners.

pois.name: Lake Hayes loop
pois.notes: 8 km flat loop, good café at the end.

pois.name: Skyline Gondola
pois.notes: Queenstown; luge at the top.

pois.name: Glenorchy
pois.notes: 45-minute lakeside drive from Queenstown.

stops.name: Te Anau
highlights: Milford Sound cruise, with Mirror Lakes on the drive in
Te Anau glowworm caves by boat
Lake Manapōuri, or an overnight cruise on Doubtful Sound
stops.tip: Keep Milford flexible and pick the best-weather day. A visitor charge for international visitors is planned there.

pois.name: Milford Sound
pois.notes: About 2 h each way from Te Anau. Book the cruise.

pois.name: Mirror Lakes
pois.notes: Short boardwalk on the Milford Road.

pois.name: Lake Manapōuri
pois.notes: Departure point for Doubtful Sound cruises.

stops.name: The Catlins
highlights: Nugget Point lighthouse and seals
Curio Bay petrified forest; yellow-eyed penguins come ashore at dusk
Purakaunui and McLean waterfalls
stops.tip: Few shops or fuel stops, so fill up in Gore or Invercargill.

pois.name: Curio Bay
pois.notes: Petrified forest at low tide; penguins at dusk. Keep well back.

pois.name: McLean Falls
pois.notes: 40-minute return walk.

pois.name: Purakaunui Falls
pois.notes: 20-minute return walk.

pois.name: Nugget Point
pois.notes: Lighthouse walk; seals on the rocks below.

stops.name: Dunedin · Otago Peninsula
highlights: Royal albatross colony at Taiaroa Head
Penguin and sea lion tours on the peninsula
St Clair beach and the Saturday farmers' market
stops.tip: Good cafés and an easy city to slow down in.

pois.name: Royal Albatross Centre
pois.notes: The only mainland royal albatross colony in the world.

pois.name: St Clair Beach
pois.notes: Hot salt-water pool on the esplanade.

pois.name: Otago Farmers Market
pois.notes: Railway station, Saturday mornings.

stops.name: Aoraki / Mt Cook
highlights: Hooker Valley Track to an iceberg lake (flat, about 3 h return)
Tasman Glacier viewpoint, a short climb
Stargazing from the village
stops.tip: Break the drive at Moeraki and Ōamaru. A visitor charge for international visitors is planned for this park.

pois.name: Moeraki Boulders
pois.notes: On the way from Dunedin. Best at low tide.

pois.name: Hooker Valley Track
pois.notes: From White Horse Hill car park. Three swing bridges.

pois.name: Tasman Glacier viewpoint
pois.notes: 20-minute climb; boat trips on the lake in summer.

stops.name: Lake Tekapo
highlights: Church of the Good Shepherd on the turquoise lake
Tekapo Springs hot pools
Night sky tour in the Dark Sky Reserve
stops.tip: The hot pools are a good way to rest after the walking.

pois.name: Church of the Good Shepherd
pois.notes: Busy at sunset; early morning is quieter.
pois.wiki: Church of the Good Shepherd (Lake Tekapo)

pois.name: Tekapo Springs
pois.notes: Hot pools; book a stargazing soak.

pois.name: Mt John Observatory
pois.notes: Walk or drive up; night tours from the village.

stops.name: Christchurch
highlights: A last night near the airport
Optional detour to Geraldine for cheese and cafés on the way
stops.tip: Stay near the airport so departure day is easy.

stops.name: Christchurch Airport
highlights: Return the car and head home
stops.tip: Allow 3 hours before an international flight.
